sentences.text: The applicant/accused seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 89/2024 of Police Station Sarai Rohilla for offence under Section 341/342/366/376/506 IPC read with Section 4 POCSO Act.

2. After addressing partly, learned counsel for accused/applicant, on instructions, seeks permission to withdraw this bail application with liberty to file a fresh application before the trial court after testimony of all public witnesses.
3. As requested, the bail application and the accompanying application are dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
